title: Planning and delivery contract with bounded consumer corrections
objective: Deliver the approved five-part planning kit with accurate source attribution, include triaged prior review points and confirmed narrow consumer corrections, and publish an independently reviewed PR.
approved_sources: User authorization 2026-10-21: implement discussed planning documentation, include independent review points and source hints, create a PR.

acceptance.description: Canonical iterative and proportionate requirements/architecture-to-planning-to-delivery handoff, responsibility, coverage and change impact.
Complete reusable planning kit and coherent hypothetical parallel-delivery example without invented approval or PASS.
Accurate primary-source notes distinguish public standard scope, optional methods and Backbone-owned rules.
Source and legacy distribution/update preserve context links, project ownership, native instructions and existing schema/state contracts.
Product fixtures are outside governance scanning; malformed governance remains rejected; complete historical bytes survive autocrlf and diagnostics are portable.
Source CI remains repository/trust bound, uses local runners without hosted fallback or uploads, retains checks and reports unavailable evidence honestly.
All incoming review points are triaged; neutral-export and optional-profile follow-up scope/acceptance are explicit.
Actual checks, independent plan/Full/Delta reviews and triage support the published PR; no merge/release.

manual_evidence: Separate quality execution and frozen behavior/authority Full reviews; triage and bounded Delta as needed
Incoming-review disposition and actual remote CI readback

stop_conditions: Scope or trust-boundary expansion requires updated independently reviewed plan.
Stop if source requirements or authorities conflict, required evidence cannot be obtained, or review budget is exhausted.
At most two Full rounds for this scope; triage before repair.
forbidden_actions: No merge, release, deployment, repository protection or runner provisioning changes.
No invented approval/runtime evidence, weakened gates, mandatory tool/domain stack, or product implementation.
No schema/state extensions, historical fixture rewrites, automatic downstream application or neutral-export runtime.
No source CI hosted-runner fallback or GitHub artifact upload.
